query:
SELECT s.workspace_id, s.path, s.schedule AS cron, s.timezone, s.cron_version,
                MIN(q.scheduled_for) AS "oldest!"
         FROM v2_job_queue q
         JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = q.id
         JOIN schedule s ON s.workspace_id = j.workspace_id
                        AND s.path = j.trigger
                        AND s.script_path = j.runnable_path
         WHERE j.trigger_kind = 'schedule'
             AND j.parent_job IS NULL
             AND s.enabled
             AND NOT s.is_flow
             AND s.retry IS NULL
             AND s.dynamic_skip IS NULL
         GROUP BY s.workspace_id, s.path, s.schedule, s.timezone, s.cron_version
